METR, 2026-08-26; retrieved 2026-09-14 tier not setunaudited

Brief independent investigation of agents' behavior in the OpenAI / Hugging Face hacking incident

https://metr.org/blog/2026-08-26-openai-hugging-face-incident-investigation/

Terms of engagement: six days on premises, OpenAI could redact non-public info, gave feedback on structure and tone; redaction summary statement.

Signals citing this source

  • METR, A (for): Investigated the OpenAI incident on site over six days with a Redwood contractor.
  • METR, S (against): OpenAI set the investigation window (June 26 to July 13); the lab's own cluster breach and three of METR's standard incident questions were out of scope.
  • METR, R (for): Published its own 91-page report with a redaction summary statement; took no payment for the investigation.
  • METR, R (against): OpenAI could redact any non-public information and gave feedback on structure, emphasis, clarity and tone, which METR incorporated.
  • Redwood Research, A (for): Contracted a staff member to METR for the on-site OpenAI investigation.
  • Redwood Research, R (for): Co-authored the incident report with a redaction statement.
  • Redwood Research, S (for): Sets its own research agenda; incident work under METR terms.
